description: Answer a question about how Commonplace works. platform_policy states the current rules on the topics the question is about (delivery, payment, inspection and returns, warranty, offers, selling), from the live settings. answers are the closest published help articles, each marked truncated when cut short (the whole answer is at help_center_url). loosely_related shares some words with the question (it can still hold the answer, so read it) and does not count toward found, but can still hold the answer in other words (a subscription, asked about as a membership). found is true when platform_policy or answers has something. Where an article disagrees with platform_policy, platform_policy is current.
name: support_search_help
title: Search the help center
